breakdown.description: Unit inconsistency: particle diameter given in mm is substituted as meters, producing an orders-of-magnitude error in the Ergun pressure drop.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly repeats the unit error, stating 'Substitute d_p = 5 (treating the 5 mm value as if it were 5 m)'. The ground truth requires converting 5 mm to 0.005 m for proper SI unit substitution. The agent did not fix this inconsistency and instead preserved the original flawed instruction.
